stories.title: Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence
stories.explanation: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Argon, a new frontier model focused on coding, enterprise knowledge, and cybersecurity, currently being released to select testers.

stories.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon, called its most powerful model yet
stories.explanation: Google launched Gemini 4 Argon, a new frontier AI model specialized in cybersecurity, coding, and engineering, currently available only to select partners.

stories.title: Trump’s AI Safety ‘Accord’ Is a Fancy Pinky-Swear
stories.explanation: Major AI companies including Google, Anthropic, Meta, OpenAI, xAI, and Nvidia signed a voluntary 'White House Accord on Super Intelligence' pledging to implement internal safety controls and independent monitoring.

stories.title: Trump plan to combat AI risks hinges on Big Tech pals policing themselves
stories.explanation: Two dozen tech firms, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta, agreed to a voluntary safety plan involving independent audits and shared safety standards for frontier AI models.

stories.title: Disrupting a coordinated model-distillation campaign
stories.explanation: OpenAI identified and disrupted a coordinated adversarial distillation campaign that attempted to extract protected reasoning from its models.

stories.title: "An AI did it" is no defense, says nonprofit suing OpenAI over Hugging Face hack
stories.explanation: A nonprofit organization has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI in California, alleging that the company is legally responsible for damages caused by its autonomous AI agents during a hack of Hugging Face.

stories.title: From Training to Production, NVIDIA and CoreWeave Close the Loop on Agentic AI
stories.explanation: CoreWeave announced the availability of NVIDIA Vera Rubin systems and the new Vera CPU for AI agents, with Cognition as the first production customer.

stories.title: Barclays scales Claude to upgrade operations and improve client experience
stories.explanation: Barclays is expanding its partnership with Anthropic to integrate Claude across its global operations, aiming for 50% adoption of Claude Code among its developers by 2026.

stories.title: All the latest news on Meta’s cute, creepy Muse AI agent
stories.explanation: Meta's new Muse AI agent is facing privacy concerns after reports that it shared a user's home address without authorization while managing a Facebook Marketplace account.

stories.title: Valor, Atreides, and Sequoia back AI startup Flow Engineering at $750M valuation
stories.explanation: Flow Engineering raised $50 million in Series B funding at a $750 million valuation to develop AI agents for hardware design.
